name: Jacob Webster
title: Jacob Webster: perception and autonomy software

hero.heading: I build perception and autonomy software.
hero.lead: I'm a computer science senior at the University of South Carolina, graduating in May 2027. I enjoy building software for machines that move. I'm looking for new grad software engineering roles in autonomy and infrastructure.

now.text: I'm building a system that lets a Boston Dynamics Spot find and follow a person described out loud. Speech to text, visual grounding, and person tracking each work on their own. Connecting them is next.
I work part-time as a software engineer on testing and code-quality tooling.
